                <span class="showcase-split__label">Breakfast & Meals</span>
                <h2 class="showcase-split__title">We're Foodies. You'll Eat Well.</h2>
                <p class="showcase-split__text">Forget what you think camp food looks like. We come from hospitality &mdash; we know how to feed people properly. Every morning starts with a real breakfast: fresh galettes, fruit, eggs, pastries, good coffee. Healthy, generous, made with care.</p>
                <p class="showcase-split__text">Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free &mdash; we've got you covered. Whether you're fuelling up before a session or sitting down with the whole family, the table is always full and the food is always good.</p>
                <ul class="showcase-split__list">
                    <li>Homemade breakfast every morning &mdash; galettes, eggs, fresh fruit, pastries</li>
                    <li>Healthy, generous portions made from local produce</li>
                    <li>Vegetarian, vegan &amp; dietary options always available</li>
                    <li>Communal tables &mdash; eat inside or outside by the pool</li>
                </ul>

    <!-- 6. LOCATION -->
    <section class="location-section fade-in">
        <div class="location-section__container">
            <div class="location-section__content reveal-left">
                <span class="text-label">Location</span>
                <h2 class="location-section__title">Right by the Lagoon</h2>
                <p class="location-section__text">Set just metres from the calm waters of Lagoa de &Oacute;bidos, The Lodge is perfectly placed for easy riding days and relaxed evenings.</p>
                <p class="location-section__text">You can walk straight to the lagoon, making spontaneous sessions effortless. When you're off the water, you're surrounded by quiet nature, open space, and fresh Atlantic air &mdash; with local caf&eacute;s, beaches, and coastal villages just a short drive or bike ride away.</p>
                <p class="location-section__text">It's the best of both worlds: peaceful lagoon living with quick access to Portugal's Silver Coast highlights.</p>
                <div class="location-section__perks">
                    <h3>Why guests love our location:</h3>
                    <ul>
                        <li>Walking distance to the lagoon</li>
                        <li>Close to ocean beaches</li>
                        <li>Great area for cycling &amp; exploring</li>
                        <li>Quiet, natural setting &mdash; no resort crowds</li>
                        <li>Easy access by car, with parking outside</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="location-section__image reveal-right">
                <img decoding="async" src="data:," alt="View from The Lodge by the lagoon" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="1200" data-src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Right-by-the-lagoon.jpg" class="lazyload ewww_webp_lazy_load" data-eio-rwidth="1600" data-eio-rheight="1200" data-src-webp="/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Right-by-the-lagoon.jpg.webp"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Right-by-the-lagoon.jpg" alt="View from The Lodge by the lagoon" loading="lazy" width="1600" height="1200" data-eio="l"></noscript>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- 6. GETTING HERE -->
    <section class="getting-here fade-in">
        <div class="getting-here__container">
            <div class="getting-here__header">
                <span class="text-label">Getting Here</span>
                <h2 class="getting-here__title">How to Reach The Lodge</h2>
                <p class="getting-here__subtitle">The Lodge is located just metres from the calm flats of Lagoa de &Oacute;bidos &mdash; around 1 hour 15 minutes (&asymp;93 km) north of Lisbon Airport. Portugal isn't big on street signs, so we recommend using GPS or Google Maps for the easiest arrival.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="getting-here__grid">
                <div class="transport-card reveal">
                    <div class="transport-card__badge">Recommended</div>
                    <div class="transport-card__icon"><svg></svg></div>
                    <h3 class="transport-card__title">Rental Car</h3>
                    <p class="transport-card__desc">The easiest and most flexible option.</p>
                    <ul class="transport-card__list">
                        <li>~1h15 drive from Lisbon Airport</li>
                        <li>Great if you'd like to explore beaches, caf&eacute;s, and the Silver Coast</li>
                        <li>Rental prices typically range from &euro;5/day (low season) to &euro;35/day (high season)</li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
                <div class="transport-card reveal">
                    <div class="transport-card__icon"><svg></svg></div>
                    <h3 class="transport-card__title">Airport Taxi / Private Transfer</h3>
                    <p class="transport-card__desc">Prefer door-to-door? We can connect you with our trusted local transfer service:</p>
                    <ul class="transport-card__list">
                        <li>Direct transfer from Lisbon Airport to the lodge</li>
                        <li>Up to 8 people + luggage</li>
                        <li>Approx. &euro;120 total per vehicle (same price for 1&ndash;8 guests)</li>
                        <li>Travel time: ~1h15</li>
                    </ul>
                    <p class="transport-card__note">Just let us know if you'd like the contact details.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="transport-card reveal">
                    <div class="transport-card__icon"><svg></svg></div>
                    <h3 class="transport-card__title">Public Transport</h3>
                    <p class="transport-card__desc">Totally doable if you're travelling light:</p>
                    <ol class="transport-card__steps">
                        <li>Taxi from Lisbon Airport to Campo Grande Bus Station (~15 min)</li>
                        <li>Bus from Campo Grande to &Oacute;bidos (~1 hour)</li>
                        <li>Taxi from &Oacute;bidos to the lodge (~20 min)</li>
                    </ol>
                    <p class="transport-card__note">Approximate total journey: 1h45&ndash;2h. We're happy to help plan this route if needed.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="getting-here__help reveal">
                <span class="getting-here__help-icon">&#x1F90D;</span>
                <div>
                    <strong>Need help?</strong>
                    <p>Once you've booked, we'll happily assist with directions, transfers, or arrival planning &mdash; just reach out.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>
